title: Smart Automation
description: Automate repetitive tasks and streamline your workflow
content:
Kahana's smart automation tools help you streamline repetitive tasks and create efficient workflows. Build custom automations that adapt to your needs while maintaining full control over your processes.

Pro Tip

Start with simple automations and gradually build more complex workflows. Use our templates as a foundation and customize them to match your specific needs.

Key Features

Workflow Builder

  • Drag-and-drop interface
  • Pre-built templates
  • Custom trigger conditions
  • Visual flow editor

Smart Rules Engine

  • Conditional logic
  • Dynamic variables
  • Custom functions
  • Error handling

Automation Capabilities

Task Automation

  • Scheduled tasks
  • Event-based triggers
  • Batch processing
  • Multi-step workflows

Integration Support

  • API connections
  • Webhook support
  • Third-party integrations
  • Custom scripts

Getting Started

1

Choose a Template

Start with one of our pre-built automation templates or create a custom workflow from scratch.

2

Configure Rules

Set up your automation rules, triggers, and conditions using our visual editor.

3

Test and Deploy

Test your automation in a safe environment before deploying to production.

Business Benefits

Increased Efficiency

Save time and reduce errors by automating repetitive tasks and workflows.

Scalable Operations

Easily scale your processes as your team and workload grow.
